name: task-breaker
description: Break any task into subtasks with configurable detail via a pluggable provider.
author: task-breaker contributors

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const dist=path.resolve('dist'); for (const [name, type] of [['esm','module'], ['cjs','commonjs']]) { const file=path.join(dist, name, 'package.json'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ type }, null, 2)); }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run pack:check
